title: Wind Chimes on the Porch
description: A weathered wooden porch at night features hanging wind chimes and a broken wooden beam. Dry autumn leaves swirl through the dark air while a mysterious glowing pinkish-purple light hovers near the steps.
prompt: A dark nighttime scene of an old weathered wooden porch with multiple wind chimes hanging from the roof, some bamboo and metal tubes, tangled strings and dry autumn leaves blowing in the wind. A broken wooden beam leans against the railing. A mysterious glowing pinkish purple light hovers near the steps. Cobwebs are visible, leaves scattered on the floorboards, moody atmospheric lighting, realistic digital painting style
